title: a merge into the commons runs the artifact door
intention: A git merge into the commons (any repo whose hook is the artifact tool's) runs the same blocking artifact check as a commit there.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: a land is a non-conflicting git merge, which runs pre-merge-commit and never pre-commit, and ~/dev/src/CairnCommons/.git/hooks holds only pre-commit and commit-msg. 6 of the last 40 commons origin/main commits are merges, so every commons land walks around the artifact check. db250e9bf3f9 closes the same hole for the cairn repo, whose hook is the tester's; the commons' hook is this tool's, installed by cairn artifact install-hook, so it is its own ticket.
traces_to: Law 4 and Law 7: the artifact door is physics only if every path into a record repo passes it, and a land is a path into the commons.
how: Add cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-merge-commit, carrying the 'artifact check' marker _install_hook already reads. It unsets GIT_INDEX_FILE and execs the installed pre-commit (git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-commit), the same shape as cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-merge-commit: during pre-merge-commit MERGE_HEAD is not yet written, so check_shared_index (cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py) would read GIT_INDEX_FILE as a shared-index commit and refuse every land; git merge refuses to start over a staged index, so the index holds only the merge. In cairn/tools/artifact/__main__.py, install-hook also installs pre-merge-commit beside pre-commit, refusing one that exists and is not this tool's, as pre-commit already does. The proof cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_a_commons_merge_runs_the_artifact_door.py builds a scratch CairnCommons repo and reaches the REAL artifact door and hooks through CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS (the pattern of test_a_commit_takes_only_the_paths_its_author_names.py, chosen at build over the stub door first planned, because it measures the real check), installs through cairn artifact install-hook, and merges --no-ff for real: a branch whose record was written around the door, and a branch whose record went through it.

clauses.claim: install-hook installs pre-merge-commit beside pre-commit, LF and executable, equal to its tracked source, and refuses a pre-merge-commit that is not this tool's

a non-conflicting merge into the record repo of a branch carrying a record written around the door is refused: git merge exits non-zero, HEAD does not move, and the artifact check speaks; red on origin/main, where it commits
a non-conflicting merge of a branch whose record went through the door commits; red with the hook's GIT_INDEX_FILE unset removed, where the shared-index guard refuses it

decisions.text: D1: cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-merge-commit unsets GIT_INDEX_FILE and execs the installed pre-commit.
D2: install-hook installs pre-merge-commit beside pre-commit, refusing a foreign one.
D3: one proof, a scratch record repo with the real door reached through CAIRN_ARTIFACT_ROOTS, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: 6 of the last 40 commons origin/main commits have two parents; ~/dev/src/CairnCommons/.git/hooks holds only pre-commit and commit-msg
measured.how: git log --format=%p -40 origin/main | awk 'NF>1' | wc -l, and ls .git/hooks

measured.saw: inside pre-merge-commit GIT_INDEX_FILE names the index and MERGE_HEAD does not exist; git merge over a staged unrelated file exits 2
measured.how: db250e9bf3f9's scratch repo with a recording pre-merge-commit hook

measured.saw: the proof is 3/3 green on the build; on origin/main@96904cace teeth 1 and 2 red (no merge hook laid; the around-the-door merge commits); with the hook's unset GIT_INDEX_FILE removed tooth 3 reds on the shared-index refusal
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec of the proof on the build, and of the same proof in a detached worktree at 96904cace, plain and with the unset line stripped

measured.saw: cairn/tools/artifact/hooks/pre-commit and pre-merge-commit carry no eol=lf attribute (the tester's hooks do); out of this ticket's bounds, reported to the orchestrator
measured.how: git check-attr eol text on the three hooks
